   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  September 9, 2024

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:18 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Sanchez. Commissioner Beacham was absent. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of
Communications and Public Affairs, Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III, and Public Safety
Commissioner Rich Le Gaspi.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Chair Leon seconded to approve the minutes for August
12, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

First Responder’s Appreciation Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda presented Commissioners with food quotes from So Cal Pizza, Wok Deli and Stater
Bros. Commissioners discussed and decided on So Cal Pizza as the lunch option. Mrs. Ocegueda
reminded Commissioners of the colored raffle ticket system that will be used. Commissioners
requested that the check-in table be outside the gates facing Clarkdale Avenue. Public Safety
Commissioner Le Gaspi confirmed that eight (8) cases of water will be donated by Norwalk-La Mirada
Plumbing Company. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners if they would like to have small index cards
placed on the tables around the centerpiece so First Responders can write thank-you notes to the
children for their placemat drawings. Commissioners liked the idea and asked Mrs. Ocegueda to
proceed with the purchase of pens and index cards.

Business Spotlight

Mr. Sun showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the August Sandwich Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda stated that staff will be out later in the week to start filming the
September edition of the Business Spotlight.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mr. Sun updated Commissioners on the new website design and some of the key features.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
September 9, 2024

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Vice Chair Ang explained that his recent absence from the Commission was due to his obligation to
working at the OC Fair in Costa Mesa. Vice Chair Ang gave positive reviews to Taco Factory, a new
restaurant in Norwalk. Commissioner Sanchez stated he just recently visited the restaurant, Papi
Churros, located at Norwalk Town Square which has been opened for some time now and enjoyed
their food. Commissioner Sanchez also reminded the Commission of the Arturo Sanchez Sr.
Halloween Parade taking place on October 12. Chair Leon visited Gorditas La Baja located on Pioneer
Blvd and stated that their food was really good and suggested to everyone to pay them a visit.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:38 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
